import pathlib,re,json,subprocess,os,time,hashlib
R=pathlib.Path(r'C:\Repos\Theory of Everything')
patterns=[r'1003\.0941',r'Axion Protection from Flavor',r'det(?:erminant)?[^\n]{0,70}(?:\bPQ\b|\bquality\b)',r'S\^6[^\n]{0,50}N',r'\(n\+5\)/2',r'det\s*M_Q',r'm_?D[^\n]{0,12}det']
rx=re.compile('|'.join(patterns),re.I)
hits=[]; count=0
paths=[R/p for p in subprocess.check_output(['rg','--files','--hidden','--no-ignore','analysis','data','papers','docs','tests','scripts'],cwd=R,text=True,encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]
paths.extend([R/'RESULTS_INDEX.md',R/'TOPICAL_ALIASES.md'])
paths.sort(key=lambda p:(p.name not in {'RESULTS_INDEX.md','TOPICAL_ALIASES.md'},not ('20261105' in p.name or '2026-11-05' in p.name or '1261' in p.name),str(p)))
skipped=[]
start=time.monotonic();budget=90;stopped=False
for p in paths:
 if time.monotonic()-start>budget or count>=30000:stopped=True;break
 if p.suffix.lower() not in {'.py','.json','.md','.tex','.html','.bib','.js'}:continue
 count+=1
 try:
  if p.stat().st_size>4000000:skipped.append(str(p.relative_to(R)));continue
  s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')
 except OSError:continue
 out=[]
 for hit in rx.finditer(s):
  out.append({'line':s.count('\n',0,hit.start())+1,'text':hit.group()[:450]})
  if len(out)>=10:break
 if out:hits.append({'file':str(p.relative_to(R)),'matches':out[:10]})
out={'files_scanned':count,'hits':hits,'skipped_over_4MB':skipped,'stopped_at_budget':stopped,'wall_budget_seconds':budget,'file_budget':30000,'patterns':patterns,'script_sha256':hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'scope':'Bounded result-oriented text search, both indexes and recent Nov5 files first; rg --no-ignore includes ignored data JSON; not exhaustive semantic review or a novelty proof. Earlier broader traversals were stopped after failing to finish promptly; first bounded trial scanned3000 files and its quality substring also matched equality, corrected with word boundaries.'}
(pathlib.Path(os.environ['TEMP'])/'toe_determinant_search_results.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
